name: Claude Science
desc: AI workbench that runs scientific analysis step by step
desc_zh: 替科学家跑分析、留痕每一步的 AI 工作台
solves: Analysis work means stitching notebooks, tools and clusters by hand; Claude Science runs the pipeline and traces each step.
solves_zh: 做科研分析要自己拼接笔记本、工具和集群，Claude Science 代跑流程并记录每一步。
best_for: You have single-cell RNA sequencing data and want a reproducible analysis before a lab meeting.
best_for_zh: 拿到单细胞测序数据，想在组会前跑出一份可复现的分析。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Beta on Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise. The announcement says the app is available in beta on macOS and Linux. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-science-ai-workbench
